title: El día de la madre
desc: May 30, and it is not negotiable
setting: It is the twenty-ninth. Marcos finds out you have made no plan at all.

steps.speaker: Marcos
steps.es: ¿Y vos qué vas a hacer mañana?
steps.en: And what are you doing tomorrow?

options.feedback: Honest, and it hands him the opening to tell you. Better than pretending you knew.

options.en: Nothing, I am going to rest.
options.feedback: Honest. Tomorrow is the thirtieth and resting is not one of the options.
Nobody is at work on the thirtieth. Ask him why he is asking.

steps.speaker: Marcos
steps.es: Es treinta de mayo, hombre. Día de la madre.
steps.en: It is the thirtieth of May, man. Mother's day.

options.es: Puchica, se me pasó. ¿Qué se hace?
options.en: Damn, it slipped past me. What does one do?
options.feedback: Puchica is the right size of oh-no, and the useful question comes straight after it.
You have caught up. Now ask what is expected of you.
True, and beside the point. There are three mothers in this street who count you as theirs.

steps.speaker: Marcos
steps.es: Se le lleva algo a la suegra. Aunque sea una flor.
steps.en: You take something to your mother-in-law. Even just a flower.

options.es: ¿Y a doña Carmen también? Ella me ha cuidado mucho.
options.en: And to doña Carmen as well? She has looked after me a lot.
options.feedback: You thought past the obligation to the person. That is the answer that gets remembered.

options.en: All right, I will take her flowers.
options.feedback: Correct and enough. You thought of one of the two.
Say that tomorrow and you will spend a year repairing it.

steps.speaker: Marcos
steps.es: Ideay, ya estás pensando como de aquí.
steps.en: Ideay, you are thinking like somebody from here now.

options.feedback: Takes the compliment, credits him, and closes it without a fuss.
Fine. It answers the words rather than what he meant by them.

options.en: It is logical, is it not?
options.feedback: It was not logical to you thirty seconds ago.
